ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $5.00 no-show fee; close the dispute with no refund to the rider.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the complaint, the chat messages [F10][F11], the driver's statement [F14] and the app reason [F4] contain no threat, harassment, sexual remark, dangerous-driving allegation or accident. Nothing to escalate.

The fee is chargeable only if every NS-1 condition holds. (i) Arrival: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 17:15:05, 40 m from the pickup point, and GPS placed him within 200 m from 17:14:35 [F2][F6][F7] — arrival proven and within the 200 m radius. (ii) Free wait: the timed wait ran from the later of scheduled pickup and arrival; the driver stayed stationary at ~40 m from 17:15:05 to cancellation at 17:22:55, i.e. 7 min 50 s [F3][F4][F6][F7], which exceeds the 5-minute free wait and also meets the 8-minute no-show threshold used in DISP-002 (the driver's reference to "the full 8 minutes the rule gives" [F14] is consistent with the elapsed 7 m 50 s actual wait running from arrival). (iii) Contact: before cancelling the driver sent 2 in-app messages (first 17:15:35) and made 1 in-app call (17:16:35, unanswered) [F5][F10][F11][F13] — the ≥1 message + ≥1 call test is met. (iv) Continuous presence: the GPS track shows him stationary at the pickup point throughout, no gap [F3][F7].

Arithmetic: the fee is the flat $5.00 cancellation fee on record [F4][F8]; no surge applies (1.0×, [F9]) and no fare build-up is in issue, so nothing to compute beyond confirming $5.00. The rider's account that he came out "a minute after the driver cancelled" is a statement contradicted by the system timeline and GPS, which control: contact was attempted from 17:15:35 and the driver waited nearly 8 minutes more [F1][F2][F3][F5][F12].

NS-2 does not apply (no condition failed), so no refund and no account flag; NS-9 does not apply (the rider's profile shows 0 no-show cancellations and the profile never decides a case anyway) [F18]. The driver's own upheld dispute is a no-show type [F19], not a route deviation, so RD-6 is not triggered. Cancellation disputes are system-final under TH-2, and the fixed $5.00 amount is within the system path.

element_findings.element: Driver cancelled for rider no-show (NS-0 characterisation)
element_findings.reason: App reason is rider_no_show and the driver's chat and statement are consistent with a no-show cancellation, so NS-1/NS-2 govern.

element_findings.element: Arrival at pickup with GPS within 200 m (NS-1(i))
element_findings.reason: "I'm Here" tapped 17:15:05 at 40 m; closest approach 36 m; within 200 m from 17:14:35 — inside the 200 m radius.
Stationary at pickup 17:15:05–17:22:55 = 7 min 50 s, exceeding both the 5-minute free wait and the 8-minute no-show threshold from DISP-002.

element_findings.element: ≥1 in-app message and ≥1 in-app call before cancelling (NS-1(iii))
element_findings.reason: Two timestamped in-app messages (17:15:35 and 17:22) and one in-app call at 17:16:35 (unanswered) were logged before the 17:22:55 cancellation.

element_findings.element: Driver remained at the pickup point throughout (NS-1(iv))
element_findings.reason: Continuous GPS presence within 200 m for the whole wait, no gap — no TH-4 escalation required.

rejected_claims.reason: Rider's claim that he came out only a minute after cancellation is contradicted by the system timeline and GPS: the driver attempted contact from 17:15:35 and remained at the pickup point until 17:22:55, over 7 minutes before cancelling [F3][F5][F6].
Profile facts (account age, rating, dispute count) never decide the current case; the rider's clean no-show history does not void a fee that otherwise satisfies every NS-1 condition.
